Counsel for Applicant :- Alok Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No. 26 of 2024 under Section 363, 366, 376 (3),
376 (2) N I.P.C. and Section 5 (J) (2), 5 (L) (6) of the POCSO Act, Police Station- Kheri, District -Lakhimpur Kheri.

3. F.I.R. in question was lodged as missing person report 25.1.2024 alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant and the other co-accused and she had also taken an amount of Rs. 10,000/-

It was subsequently stated that on the earlier occasion, the applicant had Abhishek Kumar @ Abhishekh Verma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 4 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15228829/
1 enticed away the daughter of the applicant.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the statement under Section 161 the victim stated that she was taken by the applicant under threat, however, she admitted to going with one of the co-accused to Shahjanhanpur where the applicant and other co-accused were present and after forming the physical relation she was dropped to the railway station.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. similar statement was given.
Medical on record found the victim positive for pregnancy.
It has been informed that the child has been aborted.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposes the bail application.

5. Considering the fact that the victim has admitted knowing the applicant and going to Shahjahanpur coupled with the fact the tentative age of the victim is 15-17 years., the applicant, who has no criminal history and in jail since, 10.7.2024, is enlarged on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicantAbhishek Kumar @ Abhishekh Verma be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offences of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
